decision.description: 'not a bug' if the code shown is already correct and the reported problem can't happen; then leave edits empty and explain in summary.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what you changed and why.

edits.description: Changes to existing files, applied in order. Include the test edits too.

file.description: Repository path, exactly as given in the FILE headers.

find.description: One or more whole lines copied exactly, character for character (indentation included), from that file as shown. It must appear exactly once in the file: include enough lines to make it unique.

replace.description: The text that replaces `find` (whole lines, same indentation as the file).

new_files.description: Files to create (they must not exist yet). Usually empty or left out.
